phenology_signs.name: Phenology Signs
phenology_signs.observation: When the thorn flowers and the swallows return, the old people say the fish are running and the camp should move.

controlled_undergrowth_burning.name: Controlled Undergrowth Burning
controlled_undergrowth_burning.observation: A low fire through the undergrowth in the wet season brings up green shoots that draw game and feed gatherers.

spawning_calendar.name: Spawning Calendar
spawning_calendar.observation: Fishers know the weeks each fish comes upriver to spawn, and are waiting at the pools when it does.

firebreaks.name: Firebreaks
firebreaks.observation: A cleared and scraped strip around the camp and the fields stops a grass fire at the edge.

indicator_plants.name: Indicator Plants
indicator_plants.observation: Nettle and elder mark rich ground; heather and moss mark thin, sour ground not worth the clearing.

breeding_stock_sparing.name: Breeding Stock Spared
breeding_stock_sparing.observation: Hunters let pregnant does and the young go by, so the herd is there again next year.
breeding_stock_sparing.social_consequence: A hunter who kills a pregnant doe now faces scorn at the fire.

swidden_cycle.name: Swidden Cycle
swidden_cycle.observation: Clear and burn a plot, crop it two or three years, then leave it to the forest and clear another.

leaf_fodder_pollarding.name: Leaf-fodder Pollarding
leaf_fodder_pollarding.observation: Trees cut back above a browsing animal's reach sprout leafy poles that feed the herd through winter.

hive_sparing_honey_harvest.name: Hive-sparing Honey Harvest
hive_sparing_honey_harvest.observation: Smoke the bees quiet, take part of the comb, leave the rest; the same tree gives honey every year.

drought_signs.name: Drought Signs
drought_signs.observation: When the springs run weak and the pools dry early, elders move the camp and put food by before the dry year bites.

transhumance.name: Transhumance
transhumance.observation: Herds go up to the summer pastures and come down for winter, so neither ground is grazed bare.
transhumance.social_consequence: Herding households spend the summer apart in the high pastures; the village empties of young people each season.

shellfish_bed_recovery.name: Shellfish Beds Rested
shellfish_bed_recovery.observation: A picked-over shellfish bed is left alone for a season, and the shells come back as thick as before.

copper_outcrop_signs.name: Copper Outcrop Signs
copper_outcrop_signs.observation: Green and blue stains on a rock face tell prospectors there is copper in the stone behind.

frost_pocket_reading.name: Frost Pockets and Sun Slopes
frost_pocket_reading.observation: Cold air pools in the hollows; tender crops go on the warm slope that takes the morning sun.

pest_swarm_watch.name: Pest-swarm Watch
pest_swarm_watch.observation: Watchers note the first locust hoppers in the dry gullies and warn the fields in time to harvest early.

sacred_grove_protection.name: Sacred Groves and Springs
sacred_grove_protection.observation: The grove and the spring beneath it belong to the spirits; no one cuts, herds or fouls the water there.
sacred_grove_protection.social_consequence: A man who cuts in the grove is shunned, and the spring below it runs clean.

reed_bed_rotation.name: Reed Beds Cut in Rotation
reed_bed_rotation.observation: Each reed bed is cut one year in three, so thatch never runs short and the marsh birds keep nesting.

communal_catch_limits.ability_reason: Shared limits stop the fishing ground from being emptied by the hungriest family.

flood_silt_fields.name: Flood-silt Fields
flood_silt_fields.observation: The fresh silt the flood leaves behind grows the best crops, if a field is placed to catch it and not be drowned.

wood_pasture.name: Wood-pasture
wood_pasture.observation: Thinning the trees lets grass grow beneath them; the herd grazes and the wood still stands.

coppice_regrowth_cutting.ability_reason: Coppiced stools give straight poles every few years without clearing the wood.

dung_cake_fuel.name: Dung-cake Fuel
dung_cake_fuel.observation: Where trees are few, dung patted into cakes and dried on the walls fuels the hearth.
dung_cake_fuel.social_consequence: The fields lose the dung the hearth now burns; the women who gather it gain a say over the fire.

grazing_rotation_customs.ability_reason: Rotated pastures carry the herds year after year instead of turning to dust.

waterlogging_recognition.name: Waterlogging Recognized
waterlogging_recognition.observation: Yellowing plants and sour, standing puddles show a plot has been watered too much and too often.

riparian_tree_belts.name: Riparian Tree Belts
riparian_tree_belts.observation: A belt of willow and poplar left along the banks holds them in flood and shades the water.

fuelwood_rotation.name: Fuelwood Rotation
fuelwood_rotation.observation: Each year's firewood comes from a different sector around the village, and the cut sectors are left to regrow.

spring_head_fencing.name: Spring Heads Fenced
spring_head_fencing.observation: A fence of stakes around the spring keeps the herds from trampling and fouling the water people drink.

named_soil_kinds.name: Named Soil Kinds
named_soil_kinds.observation: Heavy, light, sandy and salty ground each have a name, and each name carries its own crop and its own care.

salinity_recognition.name: Salt Crust Recognized
salinity_recognition.observation: A white crust on the watered fields and a bitter taste to the soil mean the salt is rising.
salinity_recognition.ability_reason: Irrigated fields were quietly losing yield to salt; now farmers can see it coming.

riverbank_shift_watch.name: Riverbank Shift Watch
riverbank_shift_watch.observation: Elders watch where the river is cutting and where it is building before anyone lays out a new field.

salt_leaching_fallow.name: Salted Fields Leached
salt_leaching_fallow.observation: Salted fields are flooded with fresh water, drained and left to rest until the crop will grow there again.

wetland_margin_reserves.name: Wetland Margin Reserves
wetland_margin_reserves.observation: The marsh edges are left undrained, and they keep giving fish, fowl, eggs and reeds.

stubble_grazing.name: Stubble Grazing
stubble_grazing.observation: Herds turned onto the stubble after harvest feed themselves and dung the field; before harvest they are kept out.

pit_pond_reclamation.name: Pit Ponds
pit_pond_reclamation.observation: Worked-out clay and stone pits fill with water and are kept as ponds for fish and watering the herds.

resource_use_quotas.ability_reason: Quotas spread what the land can give across every household and every year.
resource_use_quotas.social_consequence: Every household now has its measure of wood, game and clay; the headman's count, not need, sets the limit.

distant_timber_reserves.name: Distant Timber Reserves
distant_timber_reserves.observation: The long beams for great halls and boats come from known forests far upriver, not from the village woods.

salt_tolerant_barley.name: Barley on Salty Ground
salt_tolerant_barley.observation: Where wheat fails on the salty fields, barley still stands; farmers sow it there on purpose.

water_table_fallow.name: Water-table Fallow
water_table_fallow.observation: Fields are rested between water turns so the ground water sinks and carries the salt down with it.
water_table_fallow.ability_reason: Resting fields stops the slow poisoning of irrigated land.

timed_silt_clearance.name: Timed Silt Clearance
timed_silt_clearance.observation: Canals are cleared when the water is lowest, and the silt is piled on the banks, not dumped on the fields.

layered_shade_gardens.name: Layered Shade Gardens
layered_shade_gardens.observation: Beneath the date palms grow fruit trees, and beneath the fruit trees vegetables, all watered from one channel.

seasonal_herd_matching.name: Herds Matched to Pasture
seasonal_herd_matching.observation: Before the dry season, herders sell or slaughter the animals the pasture cannot carry.

dune_spread_watch.name: Dune Spread Watch
dune_spread_watch.observation: Where the sand creeps into the fields, the scrub is left standing and brush fences hold the dunes back.

deforestation_flood_link.name: Bare Hills and Fast Floods
deforestation_flood_link.observation: Elders see that since the hills were cleared, the floods come faster and carry the fields away.

mixed_flock_balance.name: Balanced Flocks
mixed_flock_balance.observation: Goats go to the scrub and sheep to the grass, in numbers each ground can bear.

sworn_fishing_closures.name: Sworn Fishing Closures
sworn_fishing_closures.observation: Villages along the river swear together not to fish during the spawning weeks.

fish_run_weir_opening.name: Weirs Opened for the Run
fish_run_weir_opening.observation: On set days the fish weirs are opened so the run can pass upstream to the villages above and the spawning beds.

vermin_control_cats.name: Cats Against Vermin
vermin_control_cats.observation: Cats are fed at the granary door and left to hunt the rats and mice in the stores and fields.

shared_woodland_boundaries.name: Shared Woodland Boundaries
shared_woodland_boundaries.observation: Neighbouring villages mark where each may cut, and no one strips a wood that another village needs.

mine_spoil_containment.name: Mine Spoil Kept from Streams
mine_spoil_containment.observation: Slag and waste rock are heaped behind banks away from the streams that water the villages below.

timed_grass_burning.name: Timed Grass Burning
timed_grass_burning.observation: The old grass is burned at the end of the rains, before the new shoots come, so the fire spares the young growth.

coppiced_charcoal_woods.name: Charcoal Coppice Woods
coppiced_charcoal_woods.observation: Woods kept for the smelters are cut in long rotation, a sector each year, so the furnaces never strip the hills.

farmers_almanac.name: Farmer's Almanac
farmers_almanac.observation: Scribes write down the farming year: when to sow, when to water, which pests come when, and what to do.
farmers_almanac.ability_reason: Written seasons let farming knowledge outlive the elders who held it.

planted_timber_groves.name: Planted Timber Groves
planted_timber_groves.observation: Poplar and tamarisk planted along the canals grow into timber where no forest ever stood.

sworn_grazing_rights.name: Sworn Grazing Rights
sworn_grazing_rights.observation: Herders and farmers swear where and when the flocks may graze, before witnesses and the god of the place.
sworn_grazing_rights.social_consequence: Trampled barley is now a matter for oath and judgment, not for blood.

protected_temple_woods.name: Protected Temple Woods
protected_temple_woods.observation: Groves of great trees are reserved for the beams of temple and palace, and guarded against every other axe.

art_proposals.note: Existing paintings proposed for NEW items once the Phase 1 art test allows them; not read by the loader.
